recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit; any future changes to the exact codes, binding strength, or whether related belongs in core require a new work-group decision rather than more FHIR-53550 application work.
issue_request: Applied/Persuasive with Modification issue objecting that DocumentReference.related was too fuzzy as a bare relationship and asking for a complex structure with a code and reference or an explicit extension approach.
initial_application: FHIR-53550's resolution explicitly says FHIR-53824 fulfills the request. The applied FHIR-53824 commits converted DocumentReference.related to a BackboneElement with CodeableConcept code and Reference(Any) target, added the AssociatedReferenceType value set, and updated the related search parameter expression.
additional_context: The linked Zulip thread and OO minutes show the intended compromise: retain a flexible Reference(Any) association but add relationship semantics and keep relatesTo for document-reference lifecycle relationships. The preceding FHIR-53824 reconciliation source commit fixed stale document-only wording left in that implementation.
reconciliation: No source change was made in this per-issue commit. After the FHIR-53824 source fix, current build-scope source already implements the requested coded related backbone and accompanying guidance.
